title: Smbclient ng: pyasn1 has quadratic-complexity denial of service in binary REAL decoding (CVE-2026-119197)
description: pyasn1 versions up to 0.6.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the decoding of binary-encoded ASN.1 REAL values with large mantissas. The decoding process has quadratic time complexity relative to the mantissa size, causing excessive CPU consumption. This affects BER, CER, and DER decoders using the vulnerable RealPayloadDecoder. The issue is fixed in pyasn1 0.6.5. Applications passing attacker-controlled ASN.1 REAL values to these decoders without proper input limits may be vulnerable to CPU exhaustion during decoding.
